location.en: Lantern Park, the campfire circle by the lake

goal.en: Share your year with the campfire circle on your last night in Maple Bay.
goal.zh: 在楓灣的最後一晚，和營火社的大家分享你這一年。

background: empty lakeside campfire circle at dusk, a warm bonfire in a stone ring, log benches in a circle, paper lanterns hanging in maple branches, golden sunset over a calm lake

intro.en: Your final evening in Maple Bay. Tomorrow morning, you fly home.
intro.zh: 你在楓灣的最後一個晚上。明天早上，你就要飛回家了。

intro.en: The campfire circle is full tonight. Hana sits in the front row with her notebook open.
intro.zh: 今晚營火圈坐滿了人。花奈坐在第一排，筆記本已經打開。

intro.en: We saved you the best seat, Kai. Right next to the fire.
intro.zh: 我們幫你留了最好的位子，凱。就在火堆旁邊。

intro.en: Tonight is a special one. Kai, this is your last campfire with us. Will you tell us about your year?
intro.zh: 今晚很特別。凱，這是你和我們的最後一次營火。願意跟大家聊聊你這一年嗎？

lines.en: Let's start at the beginning. What do you remember about your very first day in Maple Bay?
lines.zh: 我們從頭開始吧。你對來到楓灣的第一天，還記得什麼？

choices.en: I was so nervous. I practiced "Here you are" fifty times on the plane.
choices.zh: 我超緊張的。我在飛機上把「Here you are」練了五十遍。
choices.tip: 說過去的事要用過去式：I was、I practiced。具體的小細節最能打動聽眾。

choices.en: I am very nervous. I practice "Here you are" fifty times on the plane.
choices.zh: 我很緊張。我在飛機上練「Here you are」五十遍。

lines.en: You ARE nervous? Right now? Relax, Kai. You're among friends.
lines.zh: 你現在很緊張？此時此刻？放輕鬆，凱，這裡都是朋友。

story.en: Everyone tells you you're doing great. You were talking about last year, but now you really are nervous.
story.zh: 大家紛紛安慰你表現得很好。你明明在講去年的事，現在卻真的緊張起來了。

fail.why: 中文動詞沒有時態，說過去的事最容易忘記改。要用過去式：I was so nervous. I practiced...。

choices.en: Speaking of planes, does anyone here know a cheap airline to Taipei?
choices.zh: 說到飛機，這裡有人知道飛台北的便宜航空公司嗎？

lines.en: Kai, your flight is already booked. For tomorrow morning. Remember?
lines.zh: 凱，你的機票已經訂好了。明天早上。記得嗎？

story.en: Leo pulls up three airline websites anyway. The story of your first day has to wait behind ticket prices.
story.zh: 里歐還是打開了三個航空公司網站。你第一天的故事只好排在機票價格後面。

fail.why: 安柏問的是第一天的回憶，要順著問題回答：I was so nervous. I practiced "Here you are" fifty times on the plane.。

lines.en: And now, a year later. How have you changed?
lines.zh: 那現在呢，一年過去了。你有什麼改變？

choices.en: I used to be scared of mistakes. Now I see them as part of learning.
choices.zh: 我以前很怕犯錯。現在我把錯誤當成學習的一部分。
choices.tip: I used to..., now I... 是描述成長最清楚的句型，一句話對比過去和現在。

choices.en: I used to scared of mistakes. Now I am used to make them every day.
choices.zh: 我以前怕錯誤。現在我習慣每天犯錯。

lines.en: "Used to scared"? "Used to make"? Kai, you're making them right now!
lines.zh: Used to scared？Used to make？凱，你現在就在犯錯啊！

story.en: Leo writes "used to" and "be used to" in the dirt with a stick. It's a good lesson, but your big moment just became a quiz.
story.zh: 里歐拿樹枝在地上寫出 used to 和 be used to。這堂課很實用，但你的重要時刻變成了小考。

fail.why: used to 加原形動詞表示「以前會」：I used to be scared.（別漏掉 be）。be used to 加動名詞才是「習慣於」：I'm used to making mistakes.。

choices.en: A lot! Honestly, I think my English is better than Leo's now. Sorry, Leo.
choices.zh: 改變很多！老實說，我覺得我現在英文比里歐好了。抱歉啦，里歐。

lines.en: Wow. A whole year of friendship, and this is what I get.
lines.zh: 哇。一整年的友情，換來的就是這個。

story.en: Everyone laughs, and Leo pretends to be hurt for the rest of the night. You never actually said how you've changed.
story.zh: 大家都笑了，里歐整晚假裝受傷。而你其實沒說出自己改變了什麼。

fail.why: 回顧成長時拿朋友比較，就算是開玩笑也容易顯得自大。說自己的改變就好：I used to be scared of mistakes. Now I see them as part of learning.。

lines.en: What was the hardest part of your year here?
lines.zh: 這一年在這裡，最難熬的是什麼？

choices.en: Being homesick at first. But these two became my family here.
choices.zh: 一開始很想家。但這兩個人成了我在這裡的家人。
choices.tip: 誠實說出困難，再說是誰幫你走過來，這樣的回答最真誠動人。

choices.en: Ten thousand things are hard at the start, so everything was hard.
choices.zh: 萬事起頭難，所以每件事都很難。

lines.en: Ten thousand things? That's... a lot of things, Kai.
lines.zh: 一萬件事？那……真的很多耶，凱。

story.en: Hana writes down "ten thousand things" and looks worried about her own year. Ember has to reassure her after the campfire.
story.zh: 花奈寫下「一萬件事」，開始擔心起自己的這一年。營火結束後，安柏還得去安慰她。

fail.why: 「萬事起頭難」直譯會讓人以為真的有一萬件事。英文說 The first step is always the hardest.，或直接說最難的是什麼：Being homesick at first.。

choices.en: Honestly? The food. Everything here tastes so bland compared to home.
choices.zh: 老實說？食物。這裡的東西跟家鄉比起來都好清淡。

lines.en: Bland? I took you to every good restaurant in Maple Bay!
lines.zh: 清淡？我帶你吃遍了楓灣每一家好餐廳耶！

story.en: Leo spends ten minutes defending the local food. Mia agrees with you, which only makes it worse.
story.zh: 里歐花了十分鐘捍衛在地美食。米亞還站在你這邊，場面更難收拾了。

fail.why: 告別時抱怨當地食物，會讓一路帶你吃的朋友很受傷。說出真正的心路歷程：Being homesick at first. But these two became my family here.。

lines.en: Is there anyone you'd like to thank tonight?
lines.zh: 今晚有沒有想感謝的人？

lines.en: Don't look at me. I'll cry again.
lines.zh: 不要看我，我又會哭。

lines.en: Too late for me.
lines.zh: 我已經來不及了。

choices.en: All of you. Thank you for listening to all my mistakes every week.
choices.zh: 你們每一個人。謝謝你們每週聽我犯各種錯。
choices.tip: Thank you for + 動名詞，說清楚謝什麼，感謝才有份量。

choices.en: I want to thank to all of you, for listen to me every single week.
choices.zh: 我想感謝你們所有人，每週都聽我說話。

lines.en: "Thank to"? "For listen"? Kai, I listened all year for this?
lines.zh: Thank to？For listen？凱，我聽了一整年就換來這個？

story.en: Everyone gets the message, and Mia laughs through her tears. But Leo will quote "for listen" at your wedding someday.
story.zh: 大家都懂你的心意，米亞笑中帶淚。但里歐將來一定會在你的婚禮上引用 for listen。

fail.why: thank 後面直接接人，不加 to：Thank you all.。for 後面接動名詞：Thank you for listening.。

choices.en: No need to say it, right? We're family now, and family doesn't say thanks.
choices.zh: 不用說出來吧？我們已經是家人了，自己人不用謝。

lines.en: Really? Because I was kind of waiting for one.
lines.zh: 真的嗎？我其實有點在等你說耶。

story.en: You meant it as the highest compliment. Mia just looks quietly disappointed, and you give her a big hug to make up for it.
story.zh: 你本來是想表達最高的親近，米亞卻默默有點失落。你只好給她一個大擁抱補償。

fail.why: 中文常說「自己人不用謝」，但英文文化裡越親近的人，越要把感謝說出口。直接說：Thank you for listening to all my mistakes every week.。

lines.en: Last question. If you could talk to the Kai of one year ago, what would you say?
lines.zh: 最後一個問題。如果你能跟一年前的自己說話，你會說什麼？

choices.en: Don't be afraid. Say yes, make mistakes, and come to every campfire.
choices.zh: 別害怕。勇敢答應、勇敢犯錯，每一次營火都要來。
choices.tip: 給建議時用簡短的祈使句（Say yes、make mistakes），聽起來有力又溫暖。

choices.en: When the boat reaches the bridge, it goes straight. So, don't worry.
choices.zh: 船到橋頭自然直，所以不用擔心。

lines.en: A boat... and a bridge? Kai, is this a riddle?
lines.zh: 一艘船……和一座橋？凱，這是謎語嗎？

story.en: Ember explains it to the circle as "probably a Taiwanese saying." Everyone nods politely. Nobody gets it.
story.zh: 安柏跟大家解釋這「大概是台灣的俗語」。大家禮貌地點頭，但沒人聽懂。

fail.why: 「船到橋頭自然直」直譯英文聽不懂。英文相近的說法是 Things will work out.，或給具體建議：Don't be afraid. Say yes, make mistakes.。

choices.en: Don't afraid. Just say yes, make mistake, and come to every campfire.
choices.zh: 別怕。就答應、犯錯，然後每次營火都來。

lines.en: "Don't afraid"? Kai, Hana is writing that down. Fix it, quick!
lines.zh: Don't afraid？凱，花奈正在抄筆記耶。快改過來！

story.en: Hana copies your advice word for word, mistakes included. You spend the break fixing her notebook.
story.zh: 花奈一字不漏抄下你的建議，連錯誤也一起抄了。休息時間你都在幫她改筆記。

fail.why: afraid 是形容詞，前面要加 be：Don't be afraid.。mistake 是可數名詞，泛指時用複數：make mistakes。

lines.en: To Kai, and to a year of brave mistakes!
lines.zh: 敬凱，也敬這一整年勇敢犯下的錯！

lines.en: To Kai!
lines.zh: 敬凱！

lines.en: Everyone raises a marshmallow stick. In the front row, Hana underlines something in her notebook, twice.
lines.zh: 大家一起舉起烤棉花糖的竹籤。第一排的花奈，在筆記本上畫了兩道底線。

story.en: You arrived with one suitcase and a phrase you practiced fifty times. You leave with friends for life and a year of stories to tell, in English.
story.zh: 你來的時候，只有一個行李箱和一句練了五十遍的英文。離開時，你帶走了一輩子的朋友，還有一整年可以用英文說的故事。

notes.en: used to + verb / be used to + V-ing
notes.explain: used to 加原形動詞，表示「以前會，現在不會了」。be used to 加動名詞，表示「已經習慣」。兩個長得像，意思完全不同。

example.en: I used to hate mornings. Now I'm used to getting up early.
example.zh: 我以前很討厭早上。現在已經習慣早起了。

notes.en: If I could talk to..., I'd tell...
notes.zh: 如果我能跟……說話，我會告訴對方……
notes.explain: 假設語氣：if 子句用過去式 could，主句用 would。跟 If I were you, I'd... 是同一個句型家族。

example.en: If I could talk to my younger self, I'd tell them to relax.
example.zh: 如果能跟年輕時的自己說話，我會叫自己放輕鬆。

notes.explain: afraid、shy、late 都是形容詞，祈使句要加 be：Don't be afraid.、Don't be shy.、Don't be late.。中文「別怕」沒有 be，最容易漏掉。

example.en: Don't be shy. Everyone here was new once.
example.zh: 別害羞，這裡每個人都曾經是新來的。

notes.en: The first step is always the hardest.
notes.explain: 中文成語直譯通常聽不懂，要找英文裡意思相近的說法。「船到橋頭自然直」可以說 Things will work out.。

example.en: The first step is always the hardest. After that, it gets easier.
example.zh: 萬事起頭難，之後就會越來越容易。

notes.en: Thank the people closest to you.
notes.explain: 中文常說「自己人不用謝」，但在英文文化裡，對家人和好朋友說 Thank you 是表達愛的方式，不會顯得見外。說清楚謝什麼，效果更好。

example.en: Thank you for always being there for me. I mean it.
example.zh: 謝謝你一直都在我身邊。我是認真的。
